title: Substrate Parent: Restructuring the Digital Conscience
description: The logic of flattening the trunk and the transition to autonomous MetaGit synthesis.

meta.historical_context: Reflects the Pyrrho-era reordering of the Firm.

key_rules.name: Trunk Flattening
key_rules.rule: Flatten principles/ and rules/ into a single 'trunk/' directory.
key_rules.rationale: Reduces the number of navigational hops required for the agent to find core mandates.

key_rules.name: Sovereign Synthesis
key_rules.rule: Shift from manual steering to autonomous MetaGit state updates.
key_rules.rationale: Maximizes the swarm's velocity and reduces human-in-the-loop latency.
